---- MODULE W4Od0m7p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Coordinators, MaxVer

NoneOwner == "none"

VARIABLES ver, owner, phase, snapshot, log

vars == <<ver, owner, phase, snapshot, log>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
  /\ owner \in Coordinators \cup {NoneOwner}
  /\ phase \in [Coordinators -> {"idle", "reading", "crashed"}]
  /\ snapshot \in [Coordinators -> 0..MaxVer]
  /\ log \in Seq(Coordinators)

Init ==
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ owner = NoneOwner
  /\ phase = [c \in Coordinators |-> "idle"]
  /\ snapshot = [c \in Coordinators |-> 0]
  /\ log = <<>>

\* a coordinator opens the CAS cycle by snapshotting the version currently in force
ReadRecord(c) ==
  /\ phase[c] = "idle"
  /\ snapshot' = [snapshot EXCEPT ![c] = ver]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "reading"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, owner, log>>

\* the CAS itself: the write is only accepted if nobody advanced the version since our read
CasWrite(c) ==
  /\ phase[c] = "reading"
  /\ snapshot[c] = ver
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ owner' = c
  /\ log' = Append(log, c)
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED snapshot

\* either the version moved on under us, or the schedule is already full: either way the CAS
\* cannot succeed, so the coordinator gives up its stale attempt and goes back to idle
CasFailRetry(c) ==
  /\ phase[c] = "reading"
  /\ (snapshot[c] # ver \/ ver >= MaxVer)
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, owner, snapshot, log>>

\* the twist: one coordinator may vanish forever right after reading, still clutching a stale snapshot
CrashSilently(c) ==
  /\ phase[c] = "reading"
  /\ Cardinality({x \in Coordinators : phase[x] = "crashed"}) = 0
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "crashed"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, owner, snapshot, log>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Coordinators : ReadRecord(c)
  \/ \E c \in Coordinators : CasWrite(c)
  \/ \E c \in Coordinators : CasFailRetry(c)
  \/ \E c \in Coordinators : CrashSilently(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* the log of accepted writes must line up exactly with the version counter and the recorded owner,
\* which is what "no lost update" means for a CAS-guarded shared schedule slot
NoLostUpdate ==
  /\ Len(log) = ver
  /\ (ver > 0 => owner = log[ver])

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Coordinators = {c1, c2}
  MaxVer = 2

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A hospital's operating-room scheduling service lets several coordinator processes update a single shared OR-schedule record (its version number and the identity of the coordinator who last booked the room) using a compare-and-swap register instead of locks. Each coordinator first reads the record, snapshotting the version currently in force, before deciding which slot to claim. It then attempts a CAS write that only succeeds if the version is still the one it snapshotted; if some other coordinator has already advanced the version, the CAS is rejected and the coordinator abandons its stale attempt and resets to try again later. As a twist, at most one coordinator may crash silently at the exact moment after it has read the record but before it performs its CAS: it simply stops forever, still holding a stale snapshot, and is never detected or cleaned up by the others. The full action set is: ReadRecord (a coordinator snapshots the current version), CasWrite (a coordinator with a matching snapshot commits a new version and becomes the recorded owner), CasFailRetry (a coordinator whose snapshot is now stale gives up and returns to idle), and CrashSilently (an idle-to-crashed transition modeling the one permitted silent failure). The CAS guard is the only thing standing between concurrent coordinators and a lost update on the shared schedule slot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared record's version number always equals the number of CAS writes actually accepted, and its recorded owner is always the coordinator behind the most recently accepted write, so no coordinator's write can silently vanish or be overwritten out of turn.

---- MODULE W4Od16m4p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS MinCap, MaxCap, NumPrescriptions, MaxRejected

VARIABLES queue, cap, nextId, rejected, onDuty

vars == <<queue, cap, nextId, rejected, onDuty>>

Init ==
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ cap = MinCap
    /\ nextId = 1
    /\ rejected = 0
    /\ onDuty = TRUE

\* A new prescription is admitted only while staff are on duty and the queue
\* has not yet reached the capacity bound currently in force.
Enqueue ==
    /\ onDuty
    /\ nextId <= NumPrescriptions
    /\ Len(queue) < cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, nextId)
    /\ nextId' = nextId + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, rejected, onDuty>>

\* Backpressure: an arriving prescription is turned away, not queued, once the
\* queue already sits at the live capacity bound; we only tally the refusal.
RejectEnqueue ==
    /\ onDuty
    /\ nextId <= NumPrescriptions
    /\ Len(queue) >= cap
    /\ rejected < MaxRejected
    /\ rejected' = rejected + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, cap, nextId, onDuty>>

Dispense ==
    /\ queue # <<>>
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, nextId, rejected, onDuty>>

\* Management may raise the declared bound at any time, e.g. adding staff.
IncreaseCap ==
    /\ cap < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, nextId, rejected, onDuty>>

\* A shrink can never retroactively evict prescriptions already queued, so the
\* new bound may not drop below the number of prescriptions presently waiting.
DecreaseCap ==
    /\ cap > MinCap
    /\ cap - 1 >= Len(queue)
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, nextId, rejected, onDuty>>

ToggleDuty ==
    /\ onDuty' = ~onDuty
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, cap, nextId, rejected>>

Next ==
    \/ Enqueue
    \/ RejectEnqueue
    \/ Dispense
    \/ IncreaseCap
    \/ DecreaseCap
    \/ ToggleDuty

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The substantive safety claim: the work queue never holds more prescriptions
\* than whatever capacity bound is currently in force, even as that bound
\* moves up and down at runtime.
CapacityRespected == Len(queue) <= cap

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    MinCap = 1
    MaxCap = 3
    NumPrescriptions = 4
    MaxRejected = 3

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl: A pharmacy operates a bounded work queue that holds pending prescriptions waiting to be dispensed by on-duty pharmacy staff. New prescriptions are enqueued only when staff are on duty and the queue has not yet reached the currently declared capacity bound; when the queue is already full, an arriving prescription is instead turned away and counted as a backpressure rejection rather than being added to the queue. Pharmacy management can raise the declared capacity bound at any time, and can also lower it, but a lowering is only permitted down to the number of prescriptions presently queued, since prescriptions already waiting are never evicted just because the bound was tightened. Staff can also go on or off duty, which independently gates whether new prescriptions may be admitted or refused. The full action set is: Enqueue, RejectEnqueue (the backpressure refusal), Dispense, IncreaseCap, DecreaseCap, and ToggleDuty. SAFETY PROPERTY: The pending-prescription work queue never holds more prescriptions than its currently declared capacity bound, even as that bound is resized live at runtime by pharmacy operations.

---- MODULE W4Od12m1p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS SiteA, SiteB, SiteC, MsgIds, TotalUnits, MaxTransfer

Sites == {SiteA, SiteB, SiteC}
InitialSite == SiteA

VARIABLES inventory, tokenHolder, msgAmt, msgDest, transfused

vars == <<inventory, tokenHolder, msgAmt, msgDest, transfused>>

\* Recursive helper to add up a Nat-valued function over a finite domain,
\* used both for total inventory and for units currently in flight.
RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, D) == IF D = {} THEN 0
              ELSE LET d == CHOOSE x \in D : TRUE
                   IN f[d] + SumF(f, D \ {d})

\* Ring order: the token advances around a fixed cycle SiteA -> SiteB ->
\* SiteC -> SiteA, independent of any pending transfer.
RingNext(s) == CASE s = SiteA -> SiteB
                 [] s = SiteB -> SiteC
                 [] s = SiteC -> SiteA

TypeOK ==
  /\ inventory \in [Sites -> Nat]
  /\ tokenHolder \in Sites
  /\ msgAmt \in [MsgIds -> Nat]
  /\ msgDest \in [MsgIds -> Sites]
  /\ transfused \in Nat

Init ==
  /\ inventory = [s \in Sites |-> IF s = InitialSite THEN TotalUnits ELSE 0]
  /\ tokenHolder = InitialSite
  /\ msgAmt = [id \in MsgIds |-> 0]
  /\ msgDest = [id \in MsgIds |-> InitialSite]
  /\ transfused = 0

\* Token ring: possession rotates on a fixed cycle, independent of any transfer.
PassToken ==
  /\ tokenHolder' = RingNext(tokenHolder)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inventory, msgAmt, msgDest, transfused>>

\* Only the current token holder may commit units out of its own inventory.
InitiateTransfer(dest, id, amt) ==
  /\ dest # tokenHolder
  /\ msgAmt[id] = 0
  /\ inventory[tokenHolder] >= amt
  /\ inventory' = [inventory EXCEPT ![tokenHolder] = @ - amt]
  /\ msgAmt' = [msgAmt EXCEPT ![id] = amt]
  /\ msgDest' = [msgDest EXCEPT ![id] = dest]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenHolder, transfused>>

\* Channel is unordered: any pending message slot can be delivered next,
\* regardless of send order, modeling reordering of in-flight messages.
DeliverTransfer(id) ==
  /\ msgAmt[id] > 0
  /\ inventory' = [inventory EXCEPT ![msgDest[id]] = @ + msgAmt[id]]
  /\ msgAmt' = [msgAmt EXCEPT ![id] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenHolder, msgDest, transfused>>

TransfuseUnits(amt) ==
  /\ inventory[tokenHolder] >= amt
  /\ inventory' = [inventory EXCEPT ![tokenHolder] = @ - amt]
  /\ transfused' = transfused + amt
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenHolder, msgAmt, msgDest>>

Next ==
  \/ PassToken
  \/ \E dest \in Sites, id \in MsgIds, amt \in 1..MaxTransfer : InitiateTransfer(dest, id, amt)
  \/ \E id \in MsgIds : DeliverTransfer(id)
  \/ \E amt \in 1..MaxTransfer : TransfuseUnits(amt)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Nothing created or destroyed: inventory + in-flight units + transfused
\* must always sum back to the fixed total, no matter how actions interleave.
Conservation == SumF(inventory, Sites) + SumF(msgAmt, MsgIds) + transfused = TotalUnits

====

CONSTANTS
  SiteA = s1
  SiteB = s2
  SiteC = s3
  MsgIds = {m1, m2}
  TotalUnits = 4
  MaxTransfer = 2

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A regional blood-bank network keeps a fixed pool of blood units distributed across several storage sites. A single token circulates among the sites in a fixed ring order, and only the site currently holding the token is allowed to commit an outgoing transfer of units from its own inventory, whether that transfer is a shipment to another site or a unit being transfused/discarded locally. When the holder ships units to another site, the units leave its inventory immediately and become an in-flight message parked in one of a fixed number of message slots; because the network is an unordered channel, any currently pending in-flight message may be delivered to its destination site at any time, independent of the order in which messages were sent, so deliveries can be reordered relative to their sends. The token itself simply advances around the ring, independent of whether any transfer is pending. Every unit is always accounted for as either sitting in some site's inventory, riding in one of the in-flight message slots, or already transfused/discarded, and the sum of these three categories never changes from the fixed total the network started with.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state, the sum of blood units held in site inventories, units riding in pending in-flight transfer messages, and units already transfused or discarded equals the fixed total number of units the network ever received, regardless of how token passing, transfer initiation, and reordered message delivery interleave.

---- MODULE W4Od7m3p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxTerm, NoLeader, NoCrash

ASSUME NoLeader \notin Controllers /\ NoCrash \notin Controllers

VARIABLES term, leader, crashed, cmdPending, lastExec

vars == <<term, leader, crashed, cmdPending, lastExec>>

\* TypeOK is a shape check only; the real claim under test is NoStaleExecution.
TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in 1..MaxTerm
  /\ leader \in Controllers \cup {NoLeader}
  /\ crashed \in Controllers \cup {NoCrash}
  /\ cmdPending \in BOOLEAN
  /\ lastExec.ctrl \in Controllers \cup {NoLeader}
  /\ lastExec.ok \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ term = 1
  /\ leader \in Controllers
  /\ crashed = NoCrash
  /\ cmdPending = FALSE
  /\ lastExec = [ctrl |-> NoLeader, ok |-> TRUE]

\* A controller crashes silently and permanently; at most one ever does,
\* modeling the "one participant can crash silently" twist.
Crash(c) ==
  /\ crashed = NoCrash
  /\ crashed' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, cmdPending, lastExec>>

\* Failover: once the sitting leader has gone silent (or there is none yet),
\* any surviving controller can win a fresh-term election.
Elect(c) ==
  /\ c # crashed
  /\ leader # c
  /\ (leader = NoLeader \/ leader = crashed)
  /\ leader' = c
  /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
  /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, cmdPending, lastExec>>

\* The yard dispatches a new crane-move request; only one is outstanding at a time.
IssueCommand ==
  /\ ~cmdPending
  /\ cmdPending' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, crashed, lastExec>>

\* Only the live, non-crashed leader may execute. ok is captured from the very
\* guard that authorized this step, so the invariant catches any future
\* regression that lets a stale or unauthorized controller slip through.
Execute(c) ==
  /\ cmdPending
  /\ c = leader
  /\ c # crashed
  /\ cmdPending' = FALSE
  /\ lastExec' = [ctrl |-> c, ok |-> (c = leader /\ c # crashed)]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, crashed>>

CrashAction == \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
ElectAction == \E c \in Controllers : Elect(c)
ExecuteAction == \E c \in Controllers : Execute(c)

Next == IssueCommand \/ CrashAction \/ ElectAction \/ ExecuteAction

\* Fairness on election and execution (not on crash, which is adversarial and
\* optional) is what actually forces failover and dispatch to make progress.
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(ElectAction) /\ WF_vars(ExecuteAction)

\* Safety: whatever last executed did so as the live, non-crashed leader.
NoStaleExecution == lastExec.ctrl = NoLeader \/ lastExec.ok

\* Liveness: a pending crane-move request is always eventually cleared, even
\* across a silent crash and the failover election it forces.
EventuallyHandled == cmdPending ~> ~cmdPending
====

CONSTANTS
  c1 = c1
  c2 = c2
  c3 = c3
  NoLeader = NoLeader
  NoCrash = NoCrash
  Controllers = {c1, c2, c3}
  MaxTerm = 3

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT NoStaleExecution

PROPERTY EventuallyHandled
nl: A container-ship crane yard runs several redundant crane controllers, one of which is elected leader and is the only controller allowed to issue crane-move commands for the current term. The dispatch system can issue a new crane-move request whenever none is currently outstanding. At any point during the run, exactly one controller may crash silently and permanently, taking no further steps for the rest of the run, whether or not it happens to be the leader. When the sitting leader has crashed (or no leader has yet been chosen), any surviving, non-crashed controller may win a failover election, becoming leader for a fresh term. Only the controller currently holding the leader role for the live term, and only if it has not crashed, may execute an outstanding crane-move command, which clears the request. SAFETY PROPERTY: A crane-move command is only ever executed by whichever controller currently holds the leader role for the live term, so a controller that has crashed or been superseded by failover can never carry out a stale or unauthorized command. LIVENESS PROPERTY: every crane-move request is eventually handled by a valid leader, even after a leader crash triggers failover to one of the surviving controllers.
